description: Estimate at prompt submission and calibrate after each turn without storing prompt or tool content.

hooks.command: node -e "const p=require('node:path'),u=require('node:url'),r=process.env.CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT;if(!r)throw new Error('Agent ETA plugin root is unavailable');import(u.pathToFileURL(p.join(r,'dist','hook.mjs')).href).then(m=>m.runHookProcess()).catch(()=>process.stdout.write('{}\\n'))"
